observation_points.thresholds_note: Room camera: faces ~3x smaller than at the desk webcam, so a real head turn gives yaw offsets of 0.15-0.2 (F1 looking at F2, 3-12 s); 0.25 missed it. Tuned on Test_1 by inspection - validate on a held-out session.

seats_note: S1 is the single-webcam setup (points A-C). F1-B3 are the 6-person room of Test_1: F = front row, B = back row, numbered left to right in the camera image. Seat zones (geometry) are per observation point, see point T1; draw them with scripts/define_seats.py.
